note: Names in /site/tokens.css that something depends on. Values may change
freely and names may be added; removing or renaming one has to be done in
the same commit as this file, and that edit is the review signal.
Only the root site consumes the shared file so far. The four project sites
still carry their own copies, and two of them (after-hours and
IA-Economie-Strategique) use an older vocabulary entirely: --bg, --text,
for its board and heatmap. Migrating those and adding their names here is
the shared-system phase, not this one.
